request.query: membership in a finite Cartesian product of intervals iff coordinatewise bounds

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.mem_univ_Ioc
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {x : ι → ℝ} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι}, (x ∈ Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ioc (I.lower i) (I.upper i)) ↔ x ∈ I

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.mem_def
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : BoxIntegral.Box ι) {x : ι → ℝ}, x ∈ I ↔ ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Set.Ioc (I.lower i) (I.upper i)

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.mem_mk
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {l u x : ι → ℝ} {H : ∀ (i : ι), l i < u i},
  x ∈ { lower := l, upper := u, lower_lt_upper := H } ↔ ∀ (i : ι), x i ∈ Set.Ioc (l i) (u i)

items.name: BoxIntegral.Box.le_def
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I J : BoxIntegral.Box ι), I ≤ J ↔ ∀ x ∈ I, x ∈ J
